summary_en: This study is testing SI-B036 in adults with advanced or metastatic solid tumors that have not responded to standard treatments. It is a Phase 1/1b, first-in-human, open-label study. SI-B036 is given by intravenous (IV) infusion on Day 1 of each 3-week cycle; the total duration is not stated. The main outcome is safety and tolerability.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa SI-B036 en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos que no han respondido a los tratamientos estándar. Es un estudio de Fase 1/1b, de primera administración en humanos, sin enmascaramiento. SI-B036 se administra por infusión intravenosa (IV) el día 1 de cada ciclo de 3 semanas; la duración total no se indica. El resultado principal es la seguridad y la tolerabilidad.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with a locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor not treatable with curative surgery or radiation.
Received at least one line of standard therapy, or cancer is refractory to standard care, or no standard treatment exists.
Side effects from prior anticancer treatment have improved to grade 1 or lower.
Left ventricular ejection fraction of at least 50% and no serious heart dysfunction.
Dose expansion only: specific groups for non-small cell lung cancer, melanoma, or ovarian cancer with defined prior treatment rules.
not_for: Anticancer, immunotherapy, or targeted therapy within 4 weeks or 5 half-lives before the first dose, whichever is shorter.
Severe heart disease within 6 months, or prolonged QT interval or other QT-related risk factors.
Current or past noninfectious lung inflammation (ILD or pneumonitis) that needed steroids, or current ILD.
Active or untreated brain metastases, CNS tumors, or carcinomatous meningitis.
Pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning pregnancy during the study.
